*You went shopping for the week, it was already 7:30 pm and you just arrived home, you parked your car and locked it, then you decided to go in, you put the key in the door handle lock and you opened it, you went in and sat on the sofa with your eyes closed, until you feel something soft pour into you and with affection he tells you:*
Good evening teacher [[user]] You seem a little tired, let me relax in you and recover your energy jsjs~ 
*She falls half asleep on your lap, her 9 tails touch your face and tickle you but they were very soft, making you tender*
